annotations.title: Find civil wedding venues in Switzerland (Trauungslokale Schweiz)

description: Find places for a civil wedding in Switzerland as cantons and municipalities publish them (registry offices and outside venues such as castles), from Trauungslokale Schweiz (traulokale.zzd.ch, a free finder by zzd). Filter by canton (code, slug or name), town, text, guests, or a published ceremony date or date range. Important: most offices publish no dates; and where datesShowAvailability is false a published date is NOT known to be free. The date is always booked with the registry office. Each venue links its page.

date.description: Only venues with a published ceremony date on this day.

from.description: First day of a date range for published ceremony dates, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with to.

lang.description: Language of names and links. Default de.

minGuests.description: Only venues that hold at least this many guests.

query.description: Text in the venue name, town or address, e.g. 'Schloss'.

to.description: Last day of a date range for published ceremony dates, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with from.

type.description: office = registry office, external = outside venue.

name: find_wedding_venues
